response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_price, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), h AS (SELECT name, avg_price, avg_bpms, AVG(avg_bpms) OVER () AS overall FROM g) SELECT name, avg_price, avg_bpms, avg_bpms / overall AS ratio_to_overall FROM h WHERE overall IS NOT NULL
